[[File:Sink-crab.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A sink crab from [[Bestine IV/Legends|Bestine IV]].]]
A '''crab''' was a type of arthropod [[Crustacean/Legends|crustacean]] caracterized by its great pincers, carapace, and characteristic six-legged movement similar to the [[Sauvax]]'s.

Known crabs include the [[sink-crab]] of [[Bestine IV/Legends|Bestine IV]],<ref name="MTS">''[[The Movie Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref><ref name="EGP">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref><ref name="SW:POJ">''[[Star Wars: Power of the Jedi]]''</ref> the [[hitcher crab]] from [[Sevarcos II]],<ref name="COG">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref><ref name="TCWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> and the [[Vonduun crab/Legends|vonduun crab]] used by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].<ref name="VP">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref><ref name="DTII:R">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]''</ref><ref name="Traitor">''[[The New Jedi Order: Traitor]]''</ref><ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> The [[LM-432 crab droid/Legends|LM-432 droid]] was nicknamed the "crab" droid because of its similar shape.<ref name="E3:ROS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

Live crabs were an ingredient of [[crab-stuffed creampuff]]s, a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] delicacy.<ref name="Galaxy of Fear: The Doomsday Ship">''[[Galaxy of Fear: The Doomsday Ship]]''</ref>
